evidence: Full recursive listing of the frozen task (51 files) compared entry by entry with the closed list in staged-task-contract.md. Top level holds exactly instruction.md, task.toml, environment/, solution/, tests/. environment/ holds Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and six notes under instructions/ (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security, ui; the list allows 'one or more operating notes', and instruction.md:3 says 'the six notes'). tests/ holds exactly Dockerfile, test.sh, scoring.toml, app_context.md, .dockerignore, gates/{render,constraints}/{judge.toml,prompt.md}, scored/{functional,polish,visual}/{judge.toml,prompt.md}, tools/{score.py,restart_mcp.py}: every required file present, no extra tests/ entry, no tests/reward.toml; diff -rq against the frozen template tests/ reports only the task-specific prompts, judge.toml files and app_context.md as differing and no file only on one side. solution/ holds solve.sh and app/** with entry app/server.js. Must-be-absent items: a find for dotfiles, *.bak, *~, *.orig, *.map returned only tests/.dockerignore (required); no node_modules, *.db/*.db-wal, .env, NOTES.md, SOLUTION.md, zips, spreadsheets, trial runs, __pycache__, coverage.json, OS/editor junk; no zero-byte files and no CRLF files. Build output question: solution/app/public/{index.html,runner.html,assets/index.js (1,915,401 bytes),assets/index.css} is Vite output committed beside its inputs (src/, static/, index.html, vite.config.mjs, tsconfig.json, package-lock.json), and the deterministic sheet's check-no-stray-files.py names 'build output'. It is not residue here: solve.sh performs no build ('cp -a "$source_app/." "$target/"'), the agent image installs only express and better-sqlite3 globally (environment/Dockerfile), and server.js:130-131 serves 'public', so the bundle is the runtime the golden needs and falls under 'solution/app/** golden app'. It is not stale either: I copied solution/app to a scratch directory outside the workspace, ran 'npm ci --ignore-scripts' and 'npx vite build', and sha256 of public/assets/index.js, public/assets/index.css, public/index.html and public/runner.html was identical before and after; public/ contained no file the build does not produce. package-lock.json root dependencies and devDependencies equal package.json. The duplicate pairs src/style.css = public/assets/index.css (e665bd18...) and static/runner.html = public/runner.html (ed4a5811...) are build input and output, not backups. Actual-run support: the scripted golden evidence on these bytes installed with solve.sh and launched as test.sh does, so the shipped tree is sufficient to run. Residual observations, not defects: (1) solve.sh copies the build inputs (src/, static/, vite config, lockfile, root index.html) into /app although only server.js and public/ are served; harmless. (2) Whether the private check-no-stray-files.py flags the 1.9 MB unminified bundle or the task-specific seed_data.json was not measured, since the checker executable is not available; seed_data.json is on the closed list and is a known checker false positive per SKILL.md. Scope: this covers the frozen task directory only, not any packaged ZIP.
